{{incomplete|needs=Catalogue numbers, disc divisions, aspect ratio}} The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the thirteenth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, ''[[S13|Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors]]'', in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). ==Partial collections== Three ''Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors'' DVD sets were released in 2012 by [[VIZ Media]] and distributed through {{wp|Warner Home Video}}, containing the whole season between them. Each set contains two discs. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs. ===Set 1: Episodes 1-11=== [[File:DP Sinnoh League Victors Box 1 Cover.png|thumb|200px|Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors - Set 1]] Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors - Set 1 was released on February 28, 2012.
